identityScope: Four existing catalog rows in the cleaning category that previously had no field review were reviewed against current Xiaomi overview and specification pages. Robot Vacuum S10+, E10, E5 and Robot Vacuum 5 are four separate models with their own pages. No new model was created and no Xiaomi company focus review exists. The S10+ (B105) page publishes 4,000 Pa suction at four power settings, dual-pad pressure mopping with a 200 mL water tank, 3D obstacle avoidance, LDS navigation, a 450 mL dustbin, up to 120 minutes in Standard mode, a 5200 mAh nominal battery, 3.8 kg, a 350 x 350 x 97 mm body, about 6 hours charging time and a 130 x 126 x 93 mm charging base. The E10 (B112) page publishes 4,000 Pa suction at four levels, a 2-in-1 water tank and dust container, 110 minutes, a 2600 mAh nominal battery, a 325 mm by 80 mm body and a 146 x 122 x 87.5 mm dock. The E5 page publishes up to 2,000 Pa, dual side brushes, a 400 mL dustbin, 110 minutes, 2.3 kg, a 300 mm by 70 mm body, a 2600 mAh nominal battery and a 170 x 134 x 82.5 mm dock. The Robot Vacuum 5 (OV31GL) page publishes 20,000 Pa, a retractable dToF radar reaching 9.5 cm clearance, 0 mm corner reach, S-Cross structured light, an anti-tangle auto-trimming main brush, 80 C hot-water mop washing, 2-hour hot air drying, a 2.5 L dust bag rated for 75 days, 140 minutes, a 5200 mAh nominal battery, 3.75 kg, a 350 mm by 88 mm body, a 4 L clean water tank and a 470 x 360 x 572 mm dock. No reviewed page publishes a price, so all four catalog prices are cleared; the E10 and E5 pages publish no robot mass or tank capacity, and only the S10+ publishes a charging time.

fields.description: The Xiaomi Robot Vacuum S10+ (model B105) is a robot vacuum and mop with 4,000 Pa fan-blower suction at four power settings, dual-pad pressure mopping with constant moisture from a 200 mL electronically controlled water tank, 3D obstacle avoidance, an LDS laser navigation system and a 450 mL dustbin. It measures 350 x 350 x 97 mm and weighs 3.8 kg, carries a 5200 mAh nominal battery for up to 120 minutes in Standard mode, and covers over 200 m2 with one pass and up to 80 minutes of constant-moisture mopping. Its charging base measures 130 x 126 x 93 mm and charging takes about 6 hours. The pages publish no price, IP rating, payload, travel speed, cleaning width, hourly area rate or minimum aisle width; the catalog ~500 USD price is cleared.

highlights: The Xiaomi Robot Vacuum S10+ delivers 4,000 Pa fan-blower suction at four power settings with dual-pad pressure mopping and constant moisture.
A 200 mL electronically controlled water tank supports up to 80 minutes of constant-moisture mopping and covers a 150 m2 household in one pass.
3D obstacle avoidance and an LDS laser navigation system plan routes, while the 450 mL dustbin reduces emptying frequency.
A 5200 mAh nominal battery supports up to 120 minutes in Standard mode, and the robot measures 350 x 350 x 97 mm at 3.8 kg.
Charging takes about 6 hours; the pages publish no price, so the catalog ~500 USD price is cleared.

fields.description: The Xiaomi Robot Vacuum E10 (model B112) is a robot vacuum and mop with 4,000 Pa fan-blower suction at four adjustable levels, zigzag path planning, a 2-in-1 water tank and dust container, multiple sensors, and voice notifications plus Mi Home/Xiaomi Home app control. It measures 325 mm in diameter by 80 mm and carries a 2600 mAh nominal battery for 110 minutes in Standard mode. Its charging dock measures 146 x 122 x 87.5 mm. The pages publish no price, robot mass, tank capacity, charging time, IP rating, payload, travel speed, cleaning width, hourly area rate or minimum aisle width; the catalog ~200 USD price is cleared.

highlights: The Xiaomi Robot Vacuum E5 combines vacuuming and mopping with up to 2,000 Pa fan-blower suction and dual side brushes.
A nozzle design resists tangled hair, while a fixed mop plate and an infiltrating water tank handle wet cleaning.
A 400 mL dustbin and zigzag path planning reduce emptying frequency and missed spots, with drop sensing that backs the robot away from steps.
The robot measures 300 mm in diameter by 70 mm and weighs 2.3 kg, with a 2600 mAh nominal battery rated for 110 minutes in Standard gear.
The pages publish no price, tank capacity or charging time, so the catalog ~130 USD price is cleared.

fields.description: The Xiaomi Robot Vacuum 5 (model OV31GL) is a robot vacuum and mop with 20,000 Pa fan-blower suction, a retractable dToF radar that lowers the robot to clean spaces from 9.5 cm height, dual-extension side brush and mop pad reaching 0 mm at corners, S-Cross structured-light obstacle avoidance with triple laser scanning, an anti-tangle side brush with a dual-blade auto-trimming main brush, and an all-in-one dock with 80 C hot-water mop washing, 2-hour hot air drying, dual rotating scrapers and a 2.5 L dust bag rated for 75 days. It measures 350 mm in diameter by 88 mm and weighs 3.75 kg, carries a 5200 mAh nominal battery for up to 140 minutes of vacuuming and mopping in Standard mode, and pairs a 4 L clean water tank with a separate water tank and precise water output. The dock measures 470 x 360 x 572 mm with the ramp extension. The pages publish no price, charging time, IP rating, payload, travel speed, cleaning width, hourly area rate or minimum aisle width; the catalog ~700 USD price is cleared.

highlights: The Xiaomi Robot Vacuum 5 delivers 20,000 Pa fan-blower suction with a retractable dToF radar that lowers to clean spaces from 9.5 cm height.

A 5200 mAh nominal battery supports up to 140 minutes of vacuuming and mopping in Standard mode, and the 4 L clean water tank feeds precise water output.
